item: A restore waits, bounded, for the collection loop and any pass in flight to leave the corpus before it takes the working copy, and records whether it could confirm it
summary: The exclusive window stops the collection loop with a 10 s join and blocks only the NEXT Run now, so a pass deep in a write (one recorded at 39 minutes) or a pass started by Run now earlier kept writing to the live corpus after the restore had copied it, and the swap discarded what it wrote while the dialog said collection was paused. run_restore now waits up to 600 s for the loop and the busy flag before the working copy; the answer (confirmed true, false or null) is in the report and the run log, the wait is a journalled sub-stage, and the dialog reads the wait and its answer while the item runs (not only after the swap) and stops claiming a pause when it was unconfirmed (decided from the restore's own report, so a Stop pressed after the swap does not hide it). Failing test first: 11 of 53 tests red on the old merge.py. Other writers are not looked for (a proposal for the user); a Run-now pass is not signalled to stop and start() ignores the hold (the keyword lane's runner.py PR).
